text:
Maria: Heads up — telemetry sampling change from SDK v0.12 landed in prod and we're seeing quota attribution spikes on the console. Anyone else seeing weird 'unattributed' counts? :eyes:
Kevin: Yep. Cost-center tags are missing on ~20% of events; console buckets them as `unattributed` so quotas look inflated.
Ana: Which PR introduced the sampling tweak? can you paste link?
Tom: That was my change to reduce event volume. Default sampler drops metadata when request token_count < 50. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4102
Maria: That seems wrong — sampling should not drop routing/quota metadata. Billing & alerts depend on `X-Cost-Center`. This is breaking quota dashboards.
Kevin: Agreed. Proposed hotfix: add env flag to preserve metadata: `REDWOOD_SDK_PRESERVE_META=true` and revert default behavior until we implement smarter sampling.
Ana: We also need to patch the console. Current dashboard aggregates by header `X-Cost-Center` and has no fallback metrics to detect this drift.
Tom: I can cut patches for python + ts today. Plan: 0.12.1 that flips sampler to preserve metadata and exposes the env flag.
Maria: Gate rollout behind a feature-flagged canary (Dedicated accounts first). Also add a console banner: "Quota attribution lag — some events being reprocessed" while we roll.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary group ENG-PLATFORM-1 -> SDK python 0.12.1-beta
Kevin: Add an audit log entry and a telemetry regression test that asserts `cost_center` present on emitted events. We should have an e2e that compares request header -> event attribute.
Ana: I'll add a console tile change: show both `reported_cost_center` and `inferred_cost_center` counts and surface a warning if mismatch > 5%. That will help SREs quickly detect regressions.
Tom: PRs opened: python #4123, ts #4124. Added changelog/migration note: "If you rely on sampling metadata for quota attribution, set `REDWOOD_SDK_PRESERVE_META=true` or upgrade to 0.12.1."
Maria: Good. Let's treat this as low-impact if we roll back fast, but schedule a quick postmortem and update runbook. Sync at 14:00 to coordinate billing/console/SDK deploys.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Tom: I'll post links to the PRs and the canary dashboard after the 12:30 smoke tests.
Ana: Adding the console warning + a self-serve toggle in the dashboard so support can flip attribution mode if needed.
Maria: Thanks team — priority: minimize billing noise and restore correct quota mapping.
